  document.querySelectorAll('.s_card_page').forEach(function (card) {

});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const nav = document.querySelector(".nav");
  if (!nav) return;

  const drops = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(".nav_drop"));
  const list = nav.querySelector(".nav_drop_list");
  const panels = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(".nav_drop_content_wrap"));
  const backs = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(".nav_drop_back"));
  const burger = nav.querySelector(".w-nav-button");

  if (!drops.length || !list || !panels.length) return;

  const duration = 0.3;    // скорость, сек
  const closeDelay = 150;  // задержка закрытия (десктоп), мс
  const shift = 40;        // сдвиг слайда между панелями (десктоп), px
  const mobileShift = 40;  // сдвиг появления списка (мобилка), px

  const desktop = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 992px)");
  const isDesktop = () => desktop.matches;

  const panelTransition = `opacity ${duration}s ease, transform ${duration}s ease`;

  let index = -1; // -1 = закрыто
  let closeTimer = null;
  let hideTimer = null;

  /* ---------- начальные стили ---------- */

  list.style.display = "none";
  list.style.opacity = "0";
  list.style.transition = `opacity ${duration}s ease, transform ${duration}s ease`;

  panels.forEach((el) => {
    el.style.top = "0";
    el.style.left = "0";
    el.style.width = "100%";
    el.style.transition = panelTransition;
  });

  /* ---------- панели внутри списка ---------- */

  function showPanel(prev) {
    // слайд между панелями только на десктопе
    const dir = prev === -1 || !isDesktop() ? 0 : (index > prev ? 1 : -1);

    if (!dir) panels.forEach((el) => (el.style.transition = "none"));

    panels.forEach((el, i) => {
      const active = i === index;

      el.style.position = active ? "relative" : "absolute";
      el.style.pointerEvents = active ? "auto" : "none";
      el.style.zIndex = active ? "1" : "0";

      if (active) {
        if (dir) {
          el.style.transition = "none";
          el.style.transform = `translateX(${dir * shift}px)`;
          el.style.opacity = "0";
          el.offsetWidth;
          el.style.transition = panelTransition;
        }
        el.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
        el.style.opacity = "1";
      } else if (i === prev && dir) {
        el.style.transform = `translateX(${-dir * shift}px)`;
        el.style.opacity = "0";
      } else {
        el.style.opacity = "0";
      }
    });

    if (!dir) {
      panels[0].offsetWidth;
      panels.forEach((el) => (el.style.transition = panelTransition));
    }

    drops.forEach((drop, i) => drop.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index));
  }

  /* ---------- открытие / закрытие ---------- */

  function open(i) {
    clearTimeout(closeTimer);
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    if (i === index) return;

    const prev = index;
    index = i;

    if (prev === -1) {
      list.style.display = "flex";
      // на мобилке список выезжает справа, на десктопе только fade
      list.style.transform = isDesktop() ? "" : `translateX(${mobileShift}px)`;
      showPanel(prev);
      list.offsetWidth; // reflow, чтобы анимация сработала
      list.style.opacity = "1";
      list.style.transform = isDesktop() ? "" : "translateX(0)";
    } else {
      showPanel(prev);
    }
  }

  function close(instant = false) {
    clearTimeout(closeTimer);
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    index = -1;
    drops.forEach((drop) => drop.classList.remove("is-active"));

    if (instant) {
      list.style.opacity = "0";
      list.style.transform = "";
      list.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }

    list.style.opacity = "0";
    if (!isDesktop()) list.style.transform = `translateX(${mobileShift}px)`;
    hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      list.style.display = "none";
      list.style.transform = "";
    }, duration * 1000);
  }

  function scheduleClose() {
    clearTimeout(closeTimer);
    closeTimer = setTimeout(close, closeDelay);
  }

  /* ---------- десктоп: ховер ---------- */

  drops.forEach((drop, i) => {
    drop.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { if (isDesktop()) open(i); });
    drop.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { if (isDesktop()) scheduleClose(); });
  });

  list.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => { if (isDesktop()) clearTimeout(closeTimer); });
  list.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { if (isDesktop()) scheduleClose(); });

  /* ---------- мобилка: клик + назад ---------- */

  drops.forEach((drop, i) => {
    drop.addEventListener("click", () => { if (!isDesktop()) open(i); });
  });

  backs.forEach((back) => {
    back.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      close();
    });
  });

  // закрыли бургер: сбрасываем подменю, чтобы при следующем открытии был главный список
  burger && burger.addEventListener("click", () => close(true));

  // смена брейкпоинта: сбрасываем всё
  desktop.addEventListener("change", () => close(true));
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  document.querySelectorAll(".s_agents_tabs").forEach((root) => {

    const links = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".s_agents_tab_link"));
    const bgs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".s_agents_tabs_menu_bg_wrap"));
    const panels = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".s_agents_tabs_content_wrap"));

    if (!links.length) return;

    const duration = 0.35;
    let index = 0;

    /* ФОНЫ: всегда absolute на весь bg_list, меняем только opacity.
       Позицию самого bg_list не трогаем, она задана в Webflow */
    bgs.forEach((el) => {
      el.style.position = "absolute";
      el.style.inset = "0";
      el.style.transition = `opacity ${duration}s ease`;
    });

    /* КОНТЕНТ: активный relative (задаёт высоту), остальные absolute поверх */
    if (panels.length) panels[0].parentElement.style.position = "relative";
    panels.forEach((el) => {
      el.style.top = "0";
      el.style.left = "0";
      el.style.width = "100%";
      el.style.transition = `opacity ${duration}s ease`;
    });

    function sync() {
      links.forEach((el, i) => {
        el.classList.toggle("is-active", i === index);
        el.setAttribute("aria-selected", i === index ? "true" : "false");
      });

      bgs.forEach((el, i) => {
        const active = i === index;
        el.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
        el.style.opacity = active ? "1" : "0";
      });

      panels.forEach((el, i) => {
        const active = i === index;
        el.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
        el.style.position = active ? "relative" : "absolute";
        el.style.opacity = active ? "1" : "0";
        el.style.pointerEvents = active ? "auto" : "none";
        el.style.zIndex = active ? "1" : "0";
      });
    }

    links.forEach((link, i) => {
      link.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (i === index) return;
        index = i;
        sync();
      });
    });

    sync();
  });

});
